description: The goose release the Real Adapter Contract Tests lane installs. goose ships as a native binary from its GitHub releases rather than as an npm package, so it cannot ride package-lock.json; this file is its lockfile instead: one exact version, the release asset the lane downloads, and that asset's sha256, which the lane checks before unpacking. test/real_adapter_gate.py reads it for MEASURED_GOOSE_VERSION. To bump: change all three fields together, from the release's own asset, and re-measure whatever the lane then reds.
